content:
name: GitHub tracking sync

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "product/initiatives.md"
      - "product/backlog/MVP-BACKLOG.md"
      - "product/backlog/EXPANDED-BACKLOG.md"
      - "engineering/work-packets/**"
      - "scripts/sync-github-tracking.py"
      - ".github/workflows/github-tracking-sync.yml"
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "product/initiatives.md"
      - "product/backlog/MVP-BACKLOG.md"
      - "product/backlog/EXPANDED-BACKLOG.md"
      - "engineering/work-packets/**"
      - "scripts/sync-github-tracking.py"
      - ".github/workflows/github-tracking-sync.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

concurrency:
  group: github-tracking-sync
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Validate Python
        run: python3 -m py_compile scripts/sync-github-tracking.py
      - name: Validate canonical roadmap projection
        run: python3 scripts/sync-github-tracking.py --validate

  synchronize:
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Synchronize labels, milestones, issues, and hierarchy
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: python3 scripts/sync-github-tracking.py
